entities.name: Thank you for your time and for hearing my comments
entities.details: Expresses appreciation to the audience or officials for their time and attention during a public comment or meeting.

entities.name: Anyone else in the Commission
entities.details: Invites other commission members or participants to contribute or speak during the meeting.

entities.name: I move to
entities.details: A formal proposal or motion made by a participant to take a specific action or decision.

entities.name: seconded
entities.details: Indicates that another participant has supported the motion, allowing it to be considered or debated.

entities.name: respectfully ask for this one to be postponed
entities.details: A formal request to delay or defer the matter to a later time or date, made respectfully.
